description: MCP `tools/list` manifest for the 13 tools exposed by `mnm mcp serve`, in canonical registration order (search pair, chunk reads, document reads, corpus discovery, diagnostics, local install). Each tool's name, description, inputSchema, outputSchema, and annotations are part of the public contract per Constitution I and FR-037. The runtime manifest at `crates/mnm-mcp/src/tools.rs::list()` is the single source of truth: the `tools` key below is generated from it verbatim (MCP wire format) and enforced by `crates/mnm-mcp/tests/contract_sync.rs`. Regenerate with `REGENERATE_CONTRACT=1 cargo test -p mnm-mcp --test contract_sync`. Embedded schemas use JSON Schema draft 2020-12. A success result carries one text content block (summary plus a fenced trimmed-JSON view) and full-fidelity `structuredContent` conforming to the tool's outputSchema, including `suggested_next_actions`; failures use the shared envelope described under `error_envelope`.

client_model.description: EMBEDDING_MODEL_MISMATCH only: the {name}@{revision} the client embedded with.

code.description: Closed set of tool-execution error codes.

retryable.description: false means an identical retry cannot succeed — recovery needs a different call (follow suggested_next_actions).

description.description: What this suggested action achieves. Actions are suggestions, not required next steps.

tool.description: Tool to call. Absent for actions the user (not the agent) must take.

CLOUD_ERROR.description: The cloud API returned a transient or permanent error. Call `status` to diagnose if it persists.

EMBEDDING_MODEL_MISMATCH.description: The embedding model used for the query does not match the corpus's active model (FR-038 / D12). The cloud-provided `remediation` string is the next step; there is no suggested tool call because the mismatch is corpus-side.

details.corpus_model: string ({name}@{revision} of the corpus's active embedder)

INSTALL_FAILED.description: The skill file could not be written to the target harness directory.

INVALID_INPUT.description: An argument failed validation. Fix the arguments and retry.

NOT_FOUND.description: The requested chunk, document, or source does not exist. Re-derive the id (e.g. from a fresh search) before trying again.

error_envelope.description: Tool failures are MCP tool results with `isError: true` — not JSON-RPC errors. `structuredContent` carries `{ error: { code, retryable, message, ...details }, suggested_next_actions: [..] }`; the text content block carries agent-facing recovery guidance plus a trimmed `{"error":{"code","retryable"}}` JSON fence. `code` is a closed set (below). `retryable: false` means an identical retry cannot succeed — recovery requires a different call; follow `suggested_next_actions` or the guidance text. The machine-readable JSON Schema for this envelope is published as the top-level `errorSchema` key in this document (generated from `crates/mnm-mcp/src/render.rs` `ErrorKind` / `ToolFailure`, so its `code` enum, this prose, and the code never drift).

title: midnight-manual MCP tools

tools.description: Search the Midnight Network documentation and code corpus (docs, SDK references, Compact language material, code examples). Returns ranked excerpts with confidence scores and source attribution. Use it whenever you need facts about Midnight, Compact, or the Midnight SDK. Code-heavy queries (function names, API signatures, error strings from code) benefit from code_mode=exclusive; conceptual queries should keep the default. For multi-query strategies, facet filters, or rerank control, use advanced_search.

code_mode.description: Code-vector fusion (dual embeddings): on (default for hybrid/vector) fuses a voyage-code-3 ranked list alongside the general results; off = general retrieval only; exclusive = code vectors replace the general vector list (best for API-shaped / code-identifier queries). Incompatible with mode=fts.

mode.description: hybrid (default) fuses keyword + semantic; fts is keyword-only (lowest latency); vector is semantic-only.

query.description: What you want to find, as natural language or code terms.

tools.name: search

corpus_code_embedding_model.description: Present when the code-vector half ran (code_mode != off).

confidence.description: Promoted copy of scores.confidence (top-level for direct reads).

rank.description: 1-based position in the returned result list.

rerank_score.description: Voyage relevance score; present only when a local (BYOK) rerank ran.

attribution.description: Source attribution that drove the dominant trust multiplier.

relevance_source.description: Which relevance term fed the confidence blend.

matched_queries.description: Indices of the fused queries that matched (advanced_search only; basic search strips this).

tools.description: Full-control search over the Midnight corpus: fuse multiple queries (HyDE, expansion, step-back), restrict by facet filters, switch retrieval mode, and toggle reranking. Use when basic search comes up short or when the midnight-advanced-search skill prescribes a pattern. Call facets first to discover valid filter values.

code_mode.description: Code-vector fusion (dual embeddings): on (default for hybrid/vector) fuses a voyage-code-3 ranked list alongside the general results; off = general retrieval only; exclusive = code vectors replace the general vector list (best for API-shaped / code-identifier queries). Incompatible with mode=fts.

filters.description: Per-facet filters. AND across keys, OR within any_of, exclude none_of. See the `facets` tool for corpus-derived values.

mode.description: hybrid (default) fuses keyword + semantic; fts is keyword-only; vector is semantic-only.

queries.description: 1-10 query variants fused with RRF (HyDE, expansion, step-back). One query = one-element array. Rate-limit cost is one token per distinct query.

rerank.description: Apply VoyageAI reranking against the first query (server-side, or locally with your own VOYAGE_API_KEY). Disable for lowest latency.

rerank_instructions.description: Optional rerank instruction (max 400 chars). Guides relevance: emphasize aspects, filter document kinds, or disambiguate terms. Replaces the derived default instruction. Keep it terse — instruction tokens are multiplied by the candidate-pool size. See the midnight-advanced-search skill for guidance.

version_match.description: Version-filter semantics: permissive (default) biases ranking and drops only breaking mismatches among version-declaring content; strict hard-filters to satisfying content only.
